data.exact_reserve_text:
Claims incurred in the prior accident years 764 (223) 541
RITC of closed years (14,403) 6,374 (8,029)
As at the 31 December 2020, the 2018 underwriting year was reinsured to close ("RITC") externally resulting in the Syndicate having only transactions relating to 2019 to 2021 underwriting years during the 2021 financial year.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 13.639 million. This was primarily driven by a significant release of GBP 14.403 million due to the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2018 underwriting year and prior years. This RITC externally closed the 2018 year of account. Partially offsetting this release was a gross strengthening of GBP 0.764 million from claims incurred in other prior accident years (2019 and 2020). The overall movement for prior years was a release.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred in the prior accident years
the 2018 underwriting year was reinsured to close ("RITC") externally
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development includes a significant Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction, which represents a transfer of liabilities for older underwriting years rather than a pure re-estimation of existing reserves.
